exchange: Warren: 'Have Trump's tariffs increased prices for American families?' Greer: 'Senator, no' (core inflation 2.6%). Warren cites CBO/Treasury $1,700 per family, the Supreme Court ruling that the tariffs were illegal, and asks whether consumers will get refunds. Greer: refunds go to the companies that paid. NOTE: the Korea mention in this hearing (a Korean company under trade investigation) is in the opening statement, not this exchange.
